AssetView vulnerable to incorrect permission assignment for critical resource
Overview
AssetView provided by Hammock Corporation contains the following vulnerability.
Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource (CWE-732) - CVE-2026-101020
Satoru Nagaoka of Cyber Defense Institute, Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
Hammock Corporation
AssetView versions prior to Ver 13.2.7B
AssetView CLOUD Versions prior to Ver 13.2.7B (13.2 series)
AssetView CLOUD Versions prior to Ver 13.3.7 (13.3 series)
AssetView Cloud + versions prior to Ver 2600.201.11
Impact
An attacker who can log in to the Windows system where Management Console or Client Terminal for the product is running may gain SYSTEM privileges.
Solution
[Update the software or apply the patch]
AssetView:
Update the software to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
The users who cannot update the software should apply patch according to the information provided by the developer.
AssetView CLOUD:
Contact the developer's support group.
AssetView Cloud +:
Update the software to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
